violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner (26 TAC §747.2319(4))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner
violation_type.typical_finding: At time of inspection two infants over the age of twelve months were observed inside their cribs with a sippy cup each.

finding_variants.text: At time of inspection two infants over the age of twelve months were observed inside their cribs with a sippy cup each.

During the inspection I observed 4 children lying down in playpens and mats drinking a bottle or training cup.     This was corrected when the cups and bottles were removed from the children or the caregiver sat the children upright.
During the inspection I observed a 11 month old infant lying down drinking a bottle in the crib.       This was corrected when the caregiver removed the infant from the crib.

Two 9-month-old infants were observed with bottles in the playyards while they were sleeping.  The permit holder verified that the bottles are utilized to aid the infants while going to sleep.  The bottles were immediately removed during the inspection placing the operation back into compliance.
At time of inspection two infants over the age of twelve months were observed inside their crib drinking a bottle.
At time of inspection two seventeen month infants were observed inside their cribs with a sippy cup each.
